Today is Mike Brown's birthday. 💔

Though he isn't with us today, we're still demanding justice for Black lives that have been cut short by police violence. 

We fight in his name. We want accountability! ✊🏽✊🏾✊🏿 

#BlackLivesMatter
#JusticeForMikeBrown

🎨@kendrickdaye https://t.co/fPp8FUqU7r

Alton Sterling should have been celebrating his 40th birthday today. No justice ✊🏾 no peace.

#BlackLivesMatter
📸: IG - @thepaulamccarthy https://t.co/0fOPm8PiCn

Tamir Rice was a 12 yo boy who played with Legos, watched cartoons, especially Curious George, played superhero video games like Batman and TMNT, and excelled in football, swimming, and basketball. 

Tamir should have been 17 years-old today. 
Rest in Power. 

#BlackLivesMatter https://t.co/ZKpCyDAe8m

In CA & nationally, black women disproportionately “suffer life-threatening complications during pregnancy, give birth prematurely, die in childbirth & lose their babies.”

We must confront bias in the healthcare system.
#BlackLivesMatter 
https://t.co/DrChCygHYK

On this day, five years ago, Mike Brown's body lay on the streets of Ferguson MO for four hours after his murder by police. 

We will never forget the injustice, we will never forget the lives cut short, the movement it sparked.

#RestInPowerMikeBrown
